verdicts.quote: **Per axis:** Standards has 2 findings, both judgement calls, and the worst is possible Duplicated Code (finding 1). Spec has 0 requirement violations and 3 minor findings, and the worst is the unhandled missing-file traceback.
verdicts.reason: The final report covers only the Standards and Spec axes, with no Architecture section and no suggestion to set up arc42 or ADRs.
The Standards findings name the long main as a possible Long Method, framed as a judgement call, and suggest extracting load_stopwords.
